summary: LOWER makes text lowercase for a comparison.
introduction: LOWER makes text lowercase for a comparison. Your task: Search for a different beginning of a title.

Explain the example for search a lowercase form

blocks.text: LOWER makes text lowercase for a comparison. LIKE uses a pattern, where percent matches extra text.

Use MariaDB 10.11+ with its mariadb client in an empty practice database. These dialect-specific examples do not run in the site's SQLite playground. Keep the sample database separate from real records.

blocks.code: SELECT title FROM cma_maria_books WHERE LOWER(title) LIKE 'moon%';

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `SELECT` names the output values. `AS` can give a calculated result a readable column name.
`WHERE` keeps only rows that pass its condition. Check the condition with sample data before using it for a change.

blocks.text: The sample Moon Trip row matches the lowercase moon pattern.
